evidence.detail: The builder creates 600 selectable text widgets across ids 51320 through 51919 under root 51318, each with exact action text 'Select' and hover/click state enabled.
Widget 51319 is a 600-child scrolling container that receives the full selectable-text row range; root 51318 embeds that container together with existing widget 8135 and closing text widget 51920.
Client handles the exact command 'CLEAR_CLICK_TEXT_INT' by iterating widgets 51320 through 51919 and clearing their text, proving this range is a runtime-populated click-text interface.
